description:
Run a program of yours when something happens to you (a hook; only yours, your definition does not change). Changes work from the next event. The program is a tool folder or an executable; it gets the event as JSON on stdin (with "event", "hook", "stack" and the fields below). Events:
- queue_before: a message is about to enter your conversation (fields letter, content)
- queue_after: a message entered your conversation (letter, content)
- tool_before: one of your tools is about to run (name, id, arguments)
- tool_after: a tool finished, before you see its result (name, id, arguments, content, code, timed_out)
- brain_failed: your brain call failed (name = the error code, reason)
- tool_added: a tool name appeared in your tool box (name, path)
One op per call:
- list: {"op": "ls"}  (add "long": true to also see hooks you turned off)
- show one: {"op": "get", "name": "guard"}
- add: {"op": "add", "on": "tool_before", "path": "hooks/guard", "match": "agents_ctl"}  (relative paths start at your workspace; match = only for this tool name or error code)
- remove: {"op": "rm", "name": "guard"}
- back to your original hooks: {"op": "reset"}
change: true (only queue_before, tool_before, tool_after) = the program's answer counts: exit 0 with a JSON object on stdout changes the event (content, or arguments for tool_before); exit 10 blocks it (the message is dropped / the tool does not run). Without change it is only told. Any other exit code is a failure: by default you stop (on_fail "continue" = only a warning).
Errors: ArgumentsBad, OpUnknown, PathMissing, HookExists (add "replace": true to replace it), HookMissing, HooksMissing, HooksBad, NameBad, DaemonMissing, DaemonFailed, InstanceMissing.
Details: memory me.json#/self_hook.

op.description: ls = list, get = show one, add = add one, rm = remove one, reset = undo all your changes

name.description: get, rm: the hook name. add: the name to call it by (default: the folder or file name; needed with path_json)

on.description: add: the event that runs it

path.description: add: the tool folder or executable to run; relative paths start at your workspace

path_json.description: add, instead of path: a value kept as written, like {"$env": "AOS_HOME", "$path": "/lib/x"}

match.description: add: run only for this tool name (tool_before, tool_after, tool_added) or error code (brain_failed), or an array of them; not for queue events

change.description: add: true = its answer can change or block the event (queue_before, tool_before, tool_after only)

wait.description: add: false = start it and do not wait (cannot be used with change)

on_fail.description: add: when the program fails: stop (default, you stop) or continue (a warning)

timeout_ms.description: add: give up waiting after this many ms (default 60000)

replace.description: add: true replaces a hook you already have with the same name

long.description: ls: true = one text line per hook with all its settings, including hooks you turned off (null)
